title: Tail-Cuff Blood Pressure Measurement in Mice
author: Chee Lim
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yymfxu6
materials: Open the Blood Pressure Analysis software on the computer and set Preliminary Cycles at 5 and Measurement Cycles at 10.

steps.title: Prepare Equipment
steps.instruction: Power on the BP-2000 system and prepare the heating platform.

substeps.instruction: Turn on the BP-2000 computer and control unit.
Set the heating platform to approximately 34ºC.

steps.title: Position the Mouse
steps.instruction: Secure the mouse on the platform while keeping the tail accessible.

substeps.instruction: Place the mouse in the magnetic restraining device on the platform, leaving its tail free.

steps.title: Apply Tail-Cuff
steps.instruction: Secure the mouse tail within the measurement cuff.

substeps.instruction: Insert and slide the mouse tail all the way through the corresponding tail-cuff.

steps.title: Position Light Sensor
steps.instruction: Place the LED light sensor cover over the middle of the tail.

steps.title: Perform Measurement
steps.instruction: Initiate the analysis cycle to measure blood pressure.

substeps.instruction: Allow the blood pressure control unit to pressurize and depressurize to read the pulse.
Record the results presented at the end of the measurement cycle.

steps.title: Conduct Training
steps.instruction: Repeat training sessions in conjunction with data acquisition to minimize experimental variability.
